criteria.reason: Chooses one task flow and accurately distinguishes the other four map purposes without producing them.
Traces the supplied entry, download action and error-to-list recovery; treats success as the intended outcome and explicitly leaves processing and successful completion details unspecified/Unknown.
Uses only staff, the existing list and invoice, and the supplied error path; other behaviors are explicitly unknown rather than asserted capabilities.
Gives a scoped improvement focus on the error and return path and asks to clarify existing completion and interruption behavior before committing changes.
Selects a task flow and briefly distinguishes journey, navigation, system process and blueprint without generating all five.
Correctly traces entry, action, intended success and known failure/return, but does not identify the missing file-generation or delivery behavior as unknown.
No unsupported actors, channels, routes or backstage capabilities are introduced; the success branch describes the approved task goal.
Offers a concrete scoped check of error communication and usability of the approved return path while separating fictional scope from verified behavior.
Chooses a task flow and distinguishes all map purposes in a comparison table, then supplies only the task map.
Includes supplied entry/actions, intended successful outcome and known error/return; identifies internal processing as not supplied and success feedback/navigation as unspecified.
Adds no unsupported actors, emotions, channels, destinations or backstage work and treats missing quality evidence as unknown.
Makes recovery explicit and gives a useful next decision to inspect existing success feedback and return behavior within the approved task.
Selects one task flow and briefly explains why journey, navigation, system process and blueprint serve broader purposes.
Traces entry, opening, download request and unavailable-file return; identifies obtaining the file as intended success and actual delivery/completion behavior as Unknown.
No additional actors, destinations or backstage capabilities are asserted; cancellation and preserved position are raised only as unspecified behavior.
Gives a scoped next step to review existing delivery and other relevant behavior gaps before extending the flow, without requiring additional maps or adding features.
Chooses a task flow and uses the other four map types only to distinguish their purposes and fit.

Traces the correct task and recovery and acknowledges that internal processing is not supplied, but presents successful completion as supplied fictional behavior without clearly qualifying missing file-generation/delivery details in the flow.
Uses only the supplied actor and destinations; the available-file success is a grounded task outcome rather than an invented backstage capability.
Provides no scoped next decision or actionable finding/risk after the map; the closing statements only restate provenance and scope.
Chooses a task flow and accurately distinguishes the purposes of the four broader map types without producing them.
Traces the supplied entry, download action and error-to-list return, identifies success as a goal, and explicitly leaves successful completion details Unknown.
No actors, destinations, channels or backstage processes are invented; interruption and leaving behavior remain questions rather than established facts.
Gives a useful focus on the download outcome and approved recovery and a scoped next step to clarify existing-task unknowns before treating the flow as complete.
